answer: Before the stamp comes 3 letters of reference, each one priced at £55, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The desk only stamps a name that carries Corkbound riesling presser wine charter, and the stamp itself rests on a charter riesling pressers hold after press room inspections. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Every mesa is counted once. The zenith is on the docket. The clerk notes velvet.
